name: Reemergence of Chinese "Override Panda" with New Espionage Operations
description: Recently, Override Panda (APT30) has resurfaced with new phishing attack with the goal of stealing sensitive information. The latest campaign spotted by Cluster25 found out that the Override Panda utilizes a Microsoft Office document that includes a loader designed to run a shellcode, which in turn injects a beacon for "Viper". Viper is similar to Cobalt Strike, where it features over 80 modules to facilitate initial access, persistence, privilege escalation, credential access, lateral movement, and arbitrary command execution.
